data.body: S2 (f184) implemented and pushed. Plan re-reviewed and re-PASSED (v7) after I caught my own attested plan being unimplementable: it specified isinstance(profile, BedrockModelProfile) but that class is only in pydantic_ai.models.bedrock (imports botocore) and boto3 is only in the reviewbot extra, so CI lacks it — would have broken the stdlib-only import contract AND failed CI. Switched to capability-FIELD presence; added a two-layer Bedrock oracle (always-run field stub + boto3-gated verified-fake pin against the REAL BedrockProvider.model_profile) so the stub cannot drift. HOLD-OUT CLEAN THIS TIME: stripped before dispatch, never restored until validation (fixing the S1 round-2 breach). Implementer = separate standard-tier (sonnet) subagent; saw 3 of 18 tests. HELD-OUT VALIDATION: 18/18 GREEN first pass — no re-dispatch needed. TEETH CHECK all 4 mutations caught: remove Claude override => 2 failed; DROP google-vertex from resolver registry => 2 failed (the parameterized sweep bites the exact silent regression the gate warned about); lose Bedrock cache detection => 2 failed; make output_mode consult supports_thinking => caught by EXACTLY test_output_mode_does_not_consult_supports_thinking, so the provenance-vs-control-flow boundary the operator asked for is mechanically enforced, not just documented. LITMUS: renamed 4 private internals => 18/18 still green. MY OWN DEFECTS FIXED: (a) my ACs were too literal (grep-empty) and the deleted symbols survived in docstrings — reworded prose rather than reinterpret my own criterion; (b) I authored the test file at ~110 char width against a 100 limit and ruff format does not rewrap prose, so I wrote a rewrapper. ACs verified independently: both symbols grep-empty in src/+tests/, no startswith in capabilities.py, no force_prompted, NO boto3/[bedrock] added to pyproject (S3 scope respected), import rebar.llm pulls ZERO heavy modules, capabilities.py 206 LOC, providers.py still 225 (under attested cap), runner.py 787 (<800), mypy clean 383 files. Full gating suite GREEN: 7504 passed, 29 skipped, exit 0, 28m41s. Committed 09cfdddc8, Change-Id I71f2d56ea54257ea641d03617bf57e4c8a3393cf, DCO signed, 50/72 gate passed.
